title: HelperFSInventoryParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's inventory op, and they are deliberately empty. The journal is the daemon's own (`~/.nocx/fs-writes/{host}-{run}`), so a caller naming a directory could only ask a narrower question than the one worth answering. The empty shape is also the one an older generation accepts, which is what keeps the refusal for this op a fact about the helper (`unknown_op`) rather than a `bad_params` lie about the request.
